content.text: Turn on the water, splish, splash, splash,
Wet your hands, nice and fast!
Rinse the bubbles, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh,
Dry with a towel, swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!

if time>=7.20 and time<35.30 then local b=math.abs(math.sin(math.pi*(time-7.20)/0.577)); return value+Vec.v2(0,-40*b) end; return value

scale.expression: local b=0; local C={}; for i=1,#C,2 do if time>=C[i] and time<C[i+1] then b=1 end end; local p=(time+0.7)%3.9; local k=0; if p<0.08 then k=p/0.08 elseif p<0.13 then k=1 elseif p<0.21 then k=(0.21-p)/0.08 end; if b==1 then k=1 end; return Vec.v2(0.9574,0.9574*k)
